Refactor a Python retry loop into a decorator with exponential backoff and type annotations.
Write PostgreSQL to return the top three products by revenue per category for the previous calendar month.
Design a SQL query that finds users with three consecutive failed logins followed by a successful login within one hour.
Write modern CMake for a C++20 static library and GoogleTest executable using target_link_libraries and CTest.
